query: SELECT m.conversation_id, m.name, t.channel_id, COALESCE((SELECT r.started_at FROM agent_team_rounds r WHERE r.team_id = m.team_id AND r.round = m.round AND m.round > 1), m.created_at) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(mins => $1) AS "overdue!" FROM agent_team_members m JOIN agent_teams t ON t.id = m.team_id WHERE m.state = 'starting' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND i.key = CASE WHEN m.round > 1 THEN 'team-round:' || m.conversation_id::text || ':' || m.round ELSE 'team-start:' || m.conversation_id::text END)
